instruction: Candid family portrait photograph. A medium eye-level shot in a minimalist indoor studio with a white background. On the left, the young blonde girl (R2) in a light green shirt and plaid pants sits on the lap of the older man with a white beard (R1) in a light blue sweater, smiling towards the right. The man looks down with a gentle smile. On the right, the older woman with white hair and glasses (R3) in a pink sweatshirt stands close, leaning her head against his shoulder and looking upwards. The scene is softly illuminated with bright, diffused light.
